sentence: This project studies how a pericyte signaling pathway leads to white matter damage caused by chronic hypoperfusion.
This project studies how microbial variation in environmental microbiomes affects human health.
This project tries to find genes behind liver and biliary disease by assembling a large cohort of patients and applying a research pipeline for gene discovery.
This project tests whether feedback from natural language processing and artificial intelligence summaries improves patient decision making and risk communication in men with prostate cancer.
This project builds algorithms and generates data to understand biological networks that govern development in cell types related to the synovial joint.
This project tests how chemical modifications change the structure and aggregation of α-Synuclein in Parkinson’s Disease.
This project studies how a mucosal immune effector affects enterocyte nutrient uptake and systemic metabolism during bowel inflammation.
This project tries to find out how protein kinases help high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma grow and spread as spheroids.
This project looks for gene networks behind opioid addiction by combining human and rodent data with methods such as genome-wide epistasis.
This project tries to find out how Anaplasma phagocytophilum bacteria take up host iron and overcome host nutritional immunity to infect human cells.
This project studies how necroptosis affects the age-related increase in chronic inflammation.
This project studies how imprinted domains are regulated during early development, building on a nucleoporin mechanism.
This project tests an enhanced prime and pull strategy meant to make the current vaccine work better against tuberculosis.
This project looks for a class of immunotherapy targets in acute myeloid leukemia and tests potential therapies against them.
This project studies how demographic and socioeconomic factors affect the use of continuous glucose monitoring by youth with type 1 diabetes.
This project tries to find drug targets in the cellular pathways that control toxin biosynthesis in Clostridioides difficile.
This project builds mice that develop relevant aspects of Alzheimer’s disease and compares their pathologies and gene expression profiles with human signatures.
This project studies how cold temperatures change metabolism, nutrient sensing and protein quality control to extend lifespan in fruit flies.
This project builds a cloud-based toolkit that turns sinus CT scans into quantitative measures of disease severity and airflow physiology.
This project studies how nursing models of care can improve patient outcomes in hospital emergency departments.
